exact.A letter suffix to the data version indi: 数据版本后的字母后缀表示组装未变而数据有变化，例如新的基因构建。

exact.Human and Mouse have a separate cDNA dat: 人类和小鼠有单独的 cDNA 数据库，包含所有物种特异性 cDNA 与基因组序列的比对，它们作为 Ensembl 注释策略中的生物学证据来源。这些比对每个版本都会更新，因此应包含最近提交的 cDNA 序列。
exact.For human and mouse, the otherfeatures d: 对人和小鼠，otherfeatures 数据库包含物种特异性 EST 与基因组的全部比对。对其他有足够物种特异性数据的物种，otherfeatures 数据库包含物种特异性 cDNA 和 EST 与基因组的全部比对。部分 RNA-seq 数据也可能存放在 otherfeatures 数据库中。
exact.For well-characterised species with a re: 对于已有相当数量生物序列记录作为支持证据、特征研究较充分的物种，Ensembl 提供一个独立的 EST 基因集，完全基于 EST 信息。
exact.Please note that Ensembl OtherFeatures d: 请注意，Ensembl OtherFeatures 数据库不含基因组序列。这样可以节省磁盘空间，同时连接 Core 与 OtherFeatures 数据库后仍可获取序列信息。
exact.The rnaseq database contains RNA-seq bas: rnaseq 数据库包含用我们自研 RNA-seq 流程生成的基于 RNA-seq 的基因模型。该数据库还可能指向 BAM 文件。

templates.pat: All of the software created by the Ensembl project is open source and freely available to download from our {{1}}.
templates.zh: Ensembl 项目创建的所有软件都是开源的，可从我们的{{1}}免费下载。

templates.pat: The Perl API provides an abstraction layer for accessing the genomic databases. Our {{1}} includes tutorials for typical tasks, and you can also browse the {{2}} output in the Doxygen web format. If you are unable to install the API, you might prefer to use our {{3}} which comes with the API and Ensembl VEP (see below) pre-installed. The Ensembl API is compatible with Perl version 5.26+.
templates.zh: Perl API 为访问基因组数据库提供了抽象层。我们的{{1}}包含常见任务的教程，您也可以按 Doxygen 网页格式浏览{{2}}的输出。如果您无法安装 API，可以改用我们的{{3}}，其中已预装 API 与 Ensembl VEP（见下文）。Ensembl API 兼容 Perl 5.26 及以上版本。

templates.pat: The Ensembl {{1}} server allows you access to Ensembl data using any programming language. We provide a second REST server - {{2}} - for access to data on the human GRCh37 assembly.
templates.zh: Ensembl {{1}}服务器让您可以用任何编程语言访问 Ensembl 数据。我们还提供第二个 REST 服务器——{{2}}——用于访问人类 GRCh37 组装的数据。

templates.pat: In addition to the API, we provide a number of Perl scripts that use the API to run common data analyses, such as the {{1}} (Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor). All of these can be run on the command line, and some can also be run via a web front end, so you don't even need to install any software! {{2}}...
templates.zh: 除 API 之外，我们还提供若干使用该 API 的 Perl 脚本，用于常见的数据分析，例如{{1}}（Ensembl 变异效应预测器）。这些脚本都可以在命令行运行，部分还可通过网页前端运行，因此您甚至无需安装任何软件！{{2}}……

templates.pat: Many of our pipelines and back-end data processing is managed using {{1}}, a job flow system written in Perl.
templates.zh: 我们的许多流程和后端数据处理都由{{1}}管理，这是一个用 Perl 编写的作业流系统。

templates.pat: You can also run a local copy of this website by {{1}} and associated Perl dependencies. Please note that this is a non-trivial task, and we only support installation on Linux. For help with other operating systems as well as general support with custom development, we recommend joining our developers' {{2}}. The web code runs on Perl version 5.26.
templates.zh: 您也可以先{{1}}，再装好相关 Perl 依赖，从而在本地运行本网站的一份副本。请注意这并非简单的任务，我们只支持在 Linux 上安装。如果需要其他操作系统上的安装帮助，或需要定制开发方面的支持，建议加入我们开发者的{{2}}。网页代码运行于 Perl 5.26。

templates.pat: All data sets in the Ensembl system are stored in relational databases (MySQL). For each of the {{1}} the project provides a specific Perl API. As Ensembl takes also advantage of code provided by the {{2}} project; installation of the BioPerl package is included in these instructions. The Ensembl API is compatible with Perl version 5.14 through to 5.26.
templates.zh: Ensembl 系统中的所有数据集都存放在关系型数据库（MySQL）中。针对每个{{1}}，项目都提供专用的 Perl API。由于 Ensembl 也使用了{{2}}项目提供的代码，因此这些安装说明中包含了 BioPerl 软件包的安装。Ensembl API 兼容 Perl 5.14 至 5.26。

templates.pat: Ensembl has produced a video tutorial about how to install the API. Its content is based on this document so you can follow both resources when performing an installation. All commands in this video can be found from the following {{1}}.
templates.zh: Ensembl 制作了一段关于如何安装 API 的视频教程。其内容基于本文档，因此安装时可以同时参照两者。视频中的所有命令都可以在下面的{{1}}中找到。

templates.pat: There are two ways of installing the Perl API. You can {{1}} if you have that available, or you can download the files in gzipped TAR format from our {{2}}. You will also need {{3}} (bioperl-live).
templates.zh: 安装 Perl API 有两种方式。如果您能{{1}}，就用它；也可以从我们的{{2}}获取 gzip 压缩的 TAR 格式文件。您还需要{{3}}（bioperl-live）。

templates.pat: {{1}} We recommend waiting until a few days after a release before downloading the new API (or re-downloading after a few days), as there may be post-release bug fixes added to the code.
templates.zh: {{1}}建议在版本发布几天后再下载新的 API（或过几天重新下载），因为发布后可能还会向代码中加入错误修复。

templates.pat: In Windows, you will need an unzipping utility such as {{1}}.
templates.zh: 在 Windows 下，您需要解压工具，例如{{1}}。

templates.pat: In classic Windows command line, use {{1}} instead of {{2}}.
templates.zh: 在传统 Windows 命令行中，请用{{1}}代替{{2}}。

templates.pat: You have to tell Perl where to find the modules you just installed. You can do this by using the {{1}} clause in your script but if you want to make these modules available for all your scripts, the best way is to add them into the {{2}} environment variable.
templates.zh: 您必须告诉 Perl 到哪里查找刚安装的模块。可以在脚本中使用{{1}}语句来实现；但如果想让所有脚本都能用到这些模块，最好的办法是将其加入{{2}}环境变量。

templates.pat: Under {{1}}, {{2}}, or any {{3}}-derived shell:
templates.zh: 在{{1}}、{{2}}或任何基于{{3}}的 shell 中：

templates.pat: Sometimes installations can go wrong. You should follow our {{1}} to help diagnose and resolve installation issues.
templates.zh: 安装有时会出问题。您可以按照我们的{{1}}来诊断并解决安装问题。

templates.pat: Ensembl can be installed on both Windows and Mac machines however installation is not as straightforward as installing on Linux. We recommend you consult our two blog posts detailing how you can install Ensembl on {{1}} and on {{2}}. The fastest way to get up and running with Ensembl on these operating systems is to use our {{3}}.
templates.zh: Ensembl 可以安装在 Windows 和 Mac 机器上，但安装不如在 Linux 上那么直接。建议您参阅我们的两篇博客文章，其中详细介绍了如何在{{1}}和{{2}}上安装 Ensembl。在这些操作系统上最快上手 Ensembl 的方式是使用我们的{{3}}。

templates.pat: There is also an Ensembl Virtual Machine available for download which comes with the latest API pre-installed. You may download this and get started immediately with the API without having to go through the steps below. Full instructions are {{1}}
templates.zh: 此外还有可下载的 Ensembl 虚拟机，其中已预装最新的 API。您可以下载它并立即开始使用 API，无需执行下面的步骤。完整说明{{1}}。

templates.pat: Install the {{1}} to allow easy management of the Ensembl repos.
templates.zh: 安装{{1}}，以便轻松管理 Ensembl 仓库。

templates.pat: Set up your environment as described in the {{1}}.
templates.zh: 请按{{1}}中所述设置您的环境。

templates.pat: The Perl API is only one of many ways of accessing the data stored in Ensembl. Additionally there is a genome browser web interface, and the BioMart system. {{1}} may be a more appropriate tool for certain types of data mining.
templates.zh: Perl API 只是访问 Ensembl 中所存数据的众多方式之一。此外还有基因组浏览器网页界面和 BioMart 系统。对某些类型的数据挖掘，{{1}}可能更合适。

templates.pat: The Ensembl Perl APIs have easy-to-use {{1}} documentation, which provides access to all modules, listing the possible Objects and Adaptors, the functions that can be called on them and the type of output. There is also standard Perl POD (Plain Old Documentation) mixed in with the actual code, but can be automatically extracted and formatted using some software tools.
templates.zh: Ensembl Perl API 提供{{1}}文档，可以查阅所有模块，列出可用的对象与适配器、可对其调用的函数以及输出类型。实际代码中还混有标准的 Perl POD（Plain Old Documentation），可以用一些软件工具自动提取并排版。

templates.pat: The first step for working with the Perl APIs is to install the APIs and ensure your {{1}} environment variable is set up correctly (see the {{2}})
templates.zh: 使用 Perl API 的第一步是安装 API，并确保{{1}}环境变量设置正确（参见{{2}}）

templates.pat: For additional information you can contact {{1}}, the Ensembl development mailing list.
templates.zh: 如需更多信息，可以联系 Ensembl 开发邮件列表{{1}}。

templates.pat: All data used and created by Ensembl is stored in MySQL relational databases. If you want to access this database the first thing you have to do is to {{1}} to it. This is done behind the scenes by Ensembl using the standard Perl DBI module. However, if your computer is behind a firewall, you need to allow outgoing connections to the corresponding ports. You will need to know two things before you start:
templates.zh: Ensembl 使用和创建的所有数据都存放在 MySQL 关系型数据库中。如果想访问该数据库，首先要{{1}}它。Ensembl 在后台使用标准的 Perl DBI 模块完成这一连接。不过，如果您的计算机位于防火墙之后，需要允许向相应端口的出站连接。开始之前您需要了解两件事：

templates.pat: Most Objects in the API are hashes, consisting of a number of key-value pairs. You can then call a number of methods on the Objects which fetch the values. Some of these will return other Objects, some will return arrays (lists) of other Objects and some will return strings. The documentation for each Object type (for example, the {{1}}) lists the methods available, including how to call the method, any optional parameters and what type of thing will be returned.
templates.zh: API 中的大多数对象都是哈希，由若干键值对组成。随后您可以对对象调用若干方法来获取这些值。其中一些方法会返回其他对象，一些会返回其他对象的数组（列表），一些会返回字符串。每种对象类型的文档（例如{{1}}）会列出可用的方法，包括如何调用方法、有哪些可选参数以及将返回什么类型的内容。

templates.pat: Some of the data that makes up the objects returned from the Ensembl API is {{1}}. By using lazy loading, we are able to minimise the number of database queries and only "fill in" the data in the object that the program actually asked for. This makes the code faster and its memory footprint smaller, but it also means that the more data that the program requests from an object the larger it becomes. The consequence of this is that looping over a large number of these objects in some cases might grow the memory footprint of the program considerably. It also has the consequence that some objects do not load enough information and the lazy-loading can be counter productive.
templates.zh: 从 Ensembl API 返回的对象中，有些数据是{{1}}的。通过惰性加载，我们可以尽量减少数据库查询次数，只“填入”程序真正请求的对象数据。这使代码更快、内存占用更小，但也意味着程序从对象请求的数据越多，对象就越大。其后果是，在某些情况下循环遍历大量此类对象会显著增加程序的内存占用。另一个后果是，有些对象没有加载足够的信息，惰性加载反而可能适得其反。

templates.pat: By using a {{1}}-{{2}} loop rather than a {{3}} loop, the growth of the memory footprint due to lazy loading of data is more likely to stay small. This is why the comment on the last loop above says that it is a "more memory efficient way", and this is also why we use this convention for most similar loop constructs in the remainder of this API tutorial.
templates.zh: 使用{{1}}-{{2}}循环而不是{{3}}循环，因惰性加载数据而导致的内存占用增长更有可能保持较小。这就是为什么上面最后一个循环的注释说它是“更省内存的方式”，也是为什么在本 API 教程余下部分中，大多数类似的循环结构都采用这种写法。

templates.pat: The Ensembl regulation database and API are developed and maintained by the Ensembl Regulation team. The main focus of the 'funcgen' database is on experimental data which may elucidate transcriptional regulation. The schema was originally designed to support ChIP on Chip tiling array experiments but soon expanded to support other sequencing-based technologies. The original requirements supported use as a local data storage and analysis platform, as such the regulation data bases supports multiple coordinate systems. There is also support for micro array designs and externally curated data sets. See {{1}} for a summary of the data base content.
templates.zh: Ensembl 调控数据库与 API 由 Ensembl Regulation 团队开发维护。'funcgen' 数据库的主要关注点是可阐明转录调控的实验数据。该模式最初是为支持 ChIP on Chip 芯片实验而设计，但很快扩展到支持其他基于测序的技术。最初的需求是把它用作本地数据存储与分析平台，因此调控数据库支持多种坐标系。此外还支持微阵列设计和外部整理的数据集。数据库内容概览见{{1}}。
